arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the sides that brought the case claim Abood conflicts with Harris and Knox regarding speech and association.
the opposing sides assert that the government can regulate employment decisions and speech policies.
Justice Breyer questioned how far back the Court should look for precedent.
Justice Sotomayor noted the government can fire employees for off-policy speech.
